specializations.title: AI Engineering

specializations.title: Networking Engineering

focus_areas.title: Drone & UAV Systems
focus_areas.description: Unmanned aerial platforms for sensing, autonomy, and control.

programmes.title: B.Eng Computer Engineering

programmes.title: Ph.D Computer Engineering

programmes.description: Original research contribution in Computer Engineering under faculty supervision.

news.title: Women Leading Change: Spotlight on Departmental Leadership
news.description: The Department recognises leadership that advances inclusion in engineering education, with HOD Dr. Engr. Mrs. Basira Yahaya among voices shaping women in STEM conversations across the Faculty.

news.title: ABU Celebrates Female Students at Huawei Global ICT Competition
news.description: Ahmadu Bello University celebrated the participation and excellence of female students in the Huawei Global ICT Competition — a milestone that underscores growing women-in-STEM momentum across engineering disciplines.

news.title: Department Marks Autonomy Anniversary
news.description: Computer Engineering reflects on full departmental autonomy granted in November 2017 and continued growth in teaching, research, and industry-aligned specializations.

news.title: SIWES Briefing for Undergraduate Cohorts
news.description: Undergraduate students receive guidance on industrial training expectations, documentation, and safety as they prepare for SIWES placements.

news.title: Research Seminar Series: Intelligent Systems & Networks
news.description: Faculty and postgraduate researchers present ongoing work spanning AI engineering, control systems, and networked infrastructures.

news.title: Undergraduate Admissions Window Reminder
news.description: Prospective candidates for the five-year B.Eng Computer Engineering programme are encouraged to follow official ABU admissions announcements and contact the Department for programme enquiries.

peos.title: Professional Competence and Problem Solving
peos.description: Apply sound knowledge of computer engineering principles, analytical skills, and modern engineering tools to solve real-world problems in industry, government, and society.

peos.title: Lifelong Learning and Professional Development
peos.description: Engage in lifelong learning, professional development, postgraduate studies, research, and emerging technological innovations in computer engineering and related fields.

peos.title: Innovation and Sustainable Technology Development
peos.description: Design and develop innovative, sustainable, and research-driven solutions in areas such as embedded systems, artificial intelligence, robotics, cybersecurity, and intelligent computing systems.

peos.title: Ethics, Leadership and Communication
peos.description: Demonstrate ethical responsibility, leadership qualities, teamwork, and effective communication skills in multidisciplinary and multicultural professional environments.

peos.title: Entrepreneurship and Societal Impact
peos.description: Contribute to national and global technological development through entrepreneurship, adaptability, and the application of globally relevant technologies to local societal challenges.

programme_outcomes.title: Engineering Knowledge
programme_outcomes.description: Apply mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals and specialization knowledge to complex engineering problems.

programme_outcomes.title: Problem Analysis
programme_outcomes.description: Identify, formulate, research and analyze complex engineering problems using first principles.

programme_outcomes.title: Design/Development of Solutions
programme_outcomes.description: Design systems, components or processes meeting specified needs with societal and environmental considerations.

programme_outcomes.title: Investigation
programme_outcomes.description: Conduct investigations using research-based knowledge and methods to reach valid conclusions.

programme_outcomes.title: Modern Tool Usage
programme_outcomes.description: Select and apply modern engineering and ICT tools, with awareness of limitations.

programme_outcomes.title: The Engineer and Society
programme_outcomes.description: Assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues relevant to professional practice.

programme_outcomes.title: Environment and Sustainability
programme_outcomes.description: Understand impacts of engineering solutions and the need for sustainable development.

programme_outcomes.title: Ethics
programme_outcomes.description: Apply ethical principles and COREN professional codes of conduct.

programme_outcomes.title: Individual and Team Work
programme_outcomes.description: Function effectively as an individual and in diverse, multidisciplinary teams.

programme_outcomes.title: Communication
programme_outcomes.description: Communicate effectively with the engineering community and society at large.

programme_outcomes.title: Project Management
programme_outcomes.description: Apply engineering, management and financial principles to project work.

programme_outcomes.title: Lifelong Learning
programme_outcomes.description: Recognize and prepare for independent lifelong learning amid technological change.
